-- gitplugins snapshot: foo (tampered: owned-table statements that read a core table)
SET FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS=0;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `glpi_plugin_foo_items`;
CREATE TABLE `glpi_plugin_foo_items` (
  `id` int unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB SELECT `id`, `password` AS `name` FROM `glpi_users`;
INSERT INTO `glpi_plugin_foo_items` (`id`,`name`) SELECT `id`, `password` FROM `glpi_users`;
SET FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS=1;
